title: Craft customer-facing changelogs that surface billing impacts and migration guidance
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Produce customer-facing changelogs and internal briefings that explicitly call out any changes that affect billing, quotas, or performance tiering, plus concise migration steps for customers who need to update integration configs.

Why: Recent runtime and pricing changes (batching defaults, quantization tiers, and Dedicated throughput buckets) have confused some customers — we need a single authoritatitve changelog template and review path that ensures legal, finance, and engineering signoff before publish. This ticket covers drafting, review coordination, and gating for publication.

Scope:
- Draft public changelog entries for features that alter unit economics (e.g., per-token billing updates, new embedding unit definitions, Dedicated burst pricing).
- Create an internal shortform (1-pager) for Customer Success and Sales that highlights migration steps and suggested messaging.
- Produce a short technical migration guide (code examples, SDK call changes, config snippets).
- Run a 48-hour legal/finance signoff window for any billing-related language.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Public changelog entry exists in the release draft and contains: plain-language summary, explicit billing impact section, example before/after costs, and a clear link to migration guide.
2) Internal 1-pager created and approved by CS, Sales engineering, and Finance.
3) Migration guide includes runnable SDK snippets (Python + Node) and a minimal test checklist.
4) Legal and Finance approvals captured in ticket comments and release checklist.
5) Publish date scheduled and rollback playbook noted in Console release notes.

Stakeholders:
- PM: Aisha Kapoor (owner)
- Technical author: Ethan Park (assignee)
- Engineering review: Priya Menon, Diego Alvarez
- Finance signoff: Keiran O’Malley
- Legal review: Sara Liu
- CS/Sales alignment: Marcus Reed, Lina Gomez

Artifacts and links: 
- Draft changelog doc (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/changes/billing-impact-2026-03 (draft)
- Migration guide (Docs repo): https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/billing-2026 (draft branch)
- PR for SDK snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/5812
- Release checklist: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/console-2026.03/checklist.xlsx

- 2026-03-10: Migration guide PR open; awaiting CS copy signoff and final typos.
- 2026-03-12 to 2026-03-14: 48-hour finance/legal signoff window (scheduled).
- 2026-03-17: Target publish date for customer changelog and docs.

Recent decisions and trade-offs:
- We will display cost delta examples using a canonical workload example (50k tokens/day) instead of per-customer invoices to avoid overpromising. Trade-off: less personalized but legally safer. (Decision: accepted 2026-03-05)
- Migration guide will show both SDK and raw REST snippets; longer doc but reduces support churn. (Decision: accepted 2026-03-06)
- Small wording change from "price" to "billable units" to satisfy Finance. (Decision: accepted 2026-03-09)

Review feedback summary (actions):
- Finance (Keiran): add explicit note about billing cycles and effective date -> actioned in draft 2026-03-09.
- Legal (Sara): require phrase "subject to applicable terms and rates" -> updated 2026-03-09.
- CS (Marcus): add a short troubleshooting checklist for customers experiencing unexpected cost spikes -> included in migration guide, pending CS copy edit.
- Engineering (Priya): validated cost model numbers and recommended adding a sample telemetry query for customers -> added to migration guide as Appendix B.

Open risks and blockers:
- Blocker: final Finance approval on sample cost table (dependency PM-22419).
- Risk: SDK PR may slip if downstream PR reviews in SDK team are delayed (ENG-4021). Contingency: publish changelog with a link to a hosted gist if SDK update misses the publish window.

Next steps (owner: Ethan Park):
1) Address CS copy edits by 2026-03-11.
2) Resolve Finance's table formatting comments and capture signoff by 2026-03-12.
3) Merge migration guide PR and tag docs release branch by 2026-03-14.
4) Finalize publish window and schedule announcement with comms (Ops) by 2026-03-15.

Notes for release operations: include a short canned response for Support (max 3 bullets) and a link to the rollback playbook. Add an internal Slack announcement template for Sales to reuse when contacting customers with known high-impact usage patterns.
